g.text: Inside partition 1 of video-chunks: an append-only log on broker 2's disk
Video streaming with Kafka: every word from the story in one picture
200 cameras push video chunks. Readers pull them at their own speed. Arrows point from the side that sends the request.
Topics: one named log for each kind of data

text.tspan: Kafka client: fetch with long polling
Inside a group, members share the
partitions, like a queue. Each group
gets the full stream, like pub/sub.

g.text: Active segment: records, numbered by offset

text.tspan: segment, or tiered storage in S3
Reading never deletes a record. auto.offset.reset (earliest or
latest) decides where to start if a bookmark points at deleted data.
log compaction (camera-status): keep the latest record for each
key, and delete older records that have the same key.
commit the input as one step
Schema Registry: stores each record format (Avro, Protobuf,
JSON Schema) and refuses breaking changes. Aiven: Karapace.
Kafka Connect: ready-made connectors. A source connector
writes to a topic, and a sink connector reads from one.
Kafka Streams: read, compute, write, and keep state in a
changelog topic. ksqlDB and Flink do similar work.
